title: Black Light Physical FTL Route Path Sampling Registry

samplingPolicy.reason: A cosine-spaced open interval concentrates samples near departure and arrival gravity wells while still covering the interstellar interior. Endpoints themselves are excluded because a system authority position is a barycentric/catalog position, not a safe emergence point or stellar surface coordinate.

adaptiveRefinement.rule: Refine intervals when adjacent tidal Frobenius values, principal tidal eigenvalues, or acceleration vectors change faster than configured relative tolerances.

physicalNotes: Potential, acceleration, tidal tensor and curvature diagnostics are distinct quantities and are never added before dimensionless normalization.
Newtonian weak-field potential, acceleration and tidal tensors may be superposed within their approximation; exact multi-body GR invariants are not constructed by summing single-source invariants.
Route extrema are sampled extrema. They are not a mathematical proof that an unsampled interior point is less severe unless convergence/refinement criteria are satisfied.
A catalog system coordinate identifies the system reference position. It is not a canonical FTL emergence point.
The runtime may identify a route as PARTIAL because source velocity, physical radius, covariance, or epoch data are absent. PARTIAL is evidence, not failure to calculate.
canonSafeguards: This registry does not establish that any FTL method is physically realizable.
This registry does not assign a transit family to any civilization, race, vessel or manufacturer.
Route sampling derives ordinary gravitational environment only; family-boundary hazards remain operator-specific fictional variables.
Published EXAMPLE-sector values outrank generated supplements.
Candidate/disputed bodies remain excluded from confirmed route mass unless a higher authority changes their status.
Missing ephemeris, source velocity, source radius or covariance may not be silently replaced with zero.
A sampled path may inform certification only with its sampling strategy, epoch, uncertainty, model-validity state and provenance attached.
